_comment: Registered REAL Pro Link Systems marketing photos that unlock the asset-gated visual styles/formats in social_variety.py (photographic style, behind_the_scenes format). Source: Brian's Dropbox/Prolink/Marketing/2026 Photos (frames from the 2026 brand shoot), copied + optimized into assets/photos/. The autonomous social engine may use ONLY images listed here for photographic backgrounds - it never fabricates or scrapes imagery of people. Each entry carries render hints the photographic card reads: `focal` [fx,fy] (0-1) is the point kept centered when the landscape frame is cropped to a square; `text` is the safe area (top|bottom) where the headline overlay is placed so it never sits on a face; `people` flags human subjects. Remove an entry to pull it from rotation.
